abilities.name: Grid Trap / Nuke
abilities.description: Deploy traps that will ensnare enemies, locking them in place. When in Siege Mode, this ability will fire a homing Nuke which can obliterate pretty much anything. Also good for toasting marshmallows.

abilities.name: Cat Shot \ Gatling
abilities.description: Mew enemies into oblivion by shooting explosive holocats. Derpl’s love of felines should be shared with everyone. When in Siege Mode, the cats take a break and the machine gun takes over.

abilities.name: Siege Mode
abilities.description: When the going gets tough, the tough get tougher! Transform the combat walker into a stationary siege turret of doom, brandishing a free rotating machine gun in the process. Siege mode also provides debuff immunity.

abilities.name: Booster Rocket
abilities.description: Derpl's walking desk has a temporary jet boost, lifting him up high to soar with the pink elephants of joy!

This DLC contains a custom skin for Derpl in Awesomenauts, and comes with a fully customized voice set! If you have not already unlocked the character, purchasing this DLC will do so. - Official Steam Store Description.

This skin gives Derpl's walker a darker, wooden hull, although the legs are unchanged. The lights in the front are replaced with a hatch, the cat gun is an old cannon and the gatling gun spinner is a ship helm. The walker also has a black pirate flag and a parrot who leaves a trail of feathers behind as Derpl moves. Upon sieging up, the hatch is replaced by a "mermaid Derpl" statue.
Cat shot is changed to a cat holding on to a cannon ball, nuke becomes a skull and crossbones with an eye patch and grid trap is made of ropes.
Being premium, the skin comes with new voice acting as well: S.U.S.I.'s speech being replaced by the talking parrot.

Back Story.text: Riding his combat walker onto the battlefield, comes Derpl Zork. The nephew of Blabl Zork, president of Zork industries. Derpl Zork lacks his uncle's business-smarts. In fact he lacks any kind of smarts, managing to get his IQ rated under the level of plankton in the official galaxial IQ test.

Nevertheless Derpl is the heir apparent to Blabl's galaxy-spanning business empire. This is something that doesn't sit well with Blabl, not well at all. Dreading the day Derpl would inherit the company and run all the hardfought accomplishments into the ground, Blabl put Derpl in charge of fieldtesting the new Specialized Universal Secretary Interface (S.U.S.I. for short) in one of Zork Industries' combat walkers. Asking Derpl what form of devastation should be issued forth from his vehicle of destruction he simply drooled and said: "I wuv cats!"
Now Blabl is anxiously awaiting the day that Derpl would suffer a fatal blow on the fields of battle but as of yet Derpl's combat walker has proven to keep making up for its dimwitted driver.

items: Coco and Derpl were the first new characters added to the game in an update. They were released simultaneously.
Up until the addition of Professor Milton Yoolip, Derpl was the only Awesomenaut to have a known relative according to the game lore (Blabl Zork, the employer of the Awesomenauts).
Arhpl was the first premium skin not to be voiced by the same voice actor as the default skin.
Tapping the jump button slowly instead of holding it down allows Derpl to remain airborne for a longer period of time.
It is possible to drop down from glass platforms, even when you are in Siege Mode.
The Longcat upgrade for Derpl's cats allows Derpl to outrange Turrets with ease. This is only useful when something else is tanking the shots, however, as turrets are invincible when not firing.

Try to use your Grid Traps to block your enemies' paths or place them in areas they may go through, such as jump pad paths and hide areas. Placing your Grid Traps high up is also helpful, as enemy 'Nauts such as Raelynn or Rocco can accidentally jump into them, due to their single jump.

Staying near your Grid Traps is usually a good idea: if an enemy is caught on one of them, Siege up and fire a nuke at them while firing your bullets for massive amounts of damage. Getting the Empowered Grid upgrade makes this tactic even more effective, allowing you to deal more damage, enough to kill most 'Nauts.
Combining Super-powered Nuke and Combustion Lava Lamp can make it very hard for your enemies to escape from your Nuke, due to its high speed and large explosion radius.
Derpl can't be pushed while in Siege Mode.
You are immune to all forms of Crowd Control while in Siege Mode, except for Cocoon and Slowdowns.
It is possible to Siege up and charge your Nuke mid-air. This can give your enemies less time to escape the explosion.
Combining multiple defensive upgrades such as the Shields from Siege Mode and utility upgrades such as Med-i'-can and Power Pills Turbo can make Derpl extremely hard to kill while sieged.
Deployment Pads are extremely useful for escaping in a pinch while using Siege Mode, especially when fighting multiple enemy 'Nauts at once.
When facing a Raelynn, avoid entering Siege Mode on solid ground. She may easily trap you with her Timerift. Choose a glass platform instead, so you can drop down and escape her.
Use displacement and knockback to throw enemies on Derpl's traps.
If Derpl is sieged up, try and protect him as best as you can. It is very unlikely that he can flee as quickly as you can.
Like all tank characters, Derpl tends to do well when paired with 'nauts that have healing abilities.
When facing a Derpl that uses cat shot upgrades, try and stay above him for as long as you can to take advantage of the cats' bullet drop effect.
Don't waste your crowd control effects while Derpl is on Siege Mode. He is immune to all forms of crowd control except for Cocoon and Slowdowns.
Derpl can be very difficult to approach while in Siege Mode. Consider waiting until he fires his Nuke before doing so.

If you must approach Derpl while he's sieged, try to get your team to help and approach him from different sides, so that his nuke hits less people. His siege shots are also unable to pierce, so hide behind droids if there are any available.
Consider using damage amplifying abilities to counter a Derpl who stacks a lot of defensive upgrades.
With the exception of Nuke's manual detonation, Derpl has no way of dealing damage to enemies that are using Reflection or Deflection effects.
Nuke has a very clear charge-up animation before launch. Run away from Derpl if you see it!
Grid Traps make a beeping sound while active. Use that sound to know if a trap is hidden inside a hide area before entering it.
Poke Derpl while he's sieged and save your crowd control effects for when he unsieges and tries to flee.
Think twice before chasing a Derpl, especially into a hide area or with a jump pad. You might be walking into a literal trap, followed by a nuke.
